newsitem.title: JAPAN: Honda to scale back domestic output plans in July.
newsitem.headline: Honda to scale back domestic output plans in July.

text.p: Honda Motor Co Ltd said on Friday it would scale back its planned production at its two domestic plants in July in line with slowing domestic orders.
Honda will cancel its planned extra day of production in July at the No.2 line at its Sayama plant, near Tokyo, but the No.1 line will operate for two extra days as planned, a Honda spokesman said.

Honda had earlier planned to operate the No.1, No. 2 and No.3 lines at its Suzuka plant in Mie prefecture, western Japan, for two extra days in July, but now the No.1 and No.2 lines will operate for only one extra day while the No. 3 line will operate for the two extra days as planned, he said.
As a result, car production in July will fall by 2,500 units. Honda currently produces about 110,000 cars per month, the spokesman said.
Honda's plants will operate for one to two extra days in June as planned.
Honda has yet to decide its production schedule for and after August.
